scripts.check: npm test && npm run e2e:api && npm run e2e:access
scripts.export:mobile:web: cd apps/mobile && npx expo export --platform web --output-dir dist-mobile-web
scripts.mobile:config: cd apps/mobile && npx expo config --type public
scripts.mobile:build:apk: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --profile apk --platform android
scripts.mobile:build:preview: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --profile preview --platform all
scripts.mobile:build:production: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli build --profile production --platform all
scripts.mobile:submit:production: cd apps/mobile && npx eas-cli submit --profile production --platform all
scripts.release:check: npm run check && npm run build:web && npm run doctor:mobile && npm run export:mobile:web
